summary: -i is parsed into iterations, and the timed region launches the selected CUDA kernel once per iteration when dimensions/count are nonzero. The row-strided kernel covers all rows and traverses their CSR entries. No separate warm-up exists in this version, but no timed work is omitted.

source_evidence.claim: -i stores the requested count; the kernel distributes rows across lanes and visits each row's CSR entries. The timed loop launches once per iter and synchronizes before stopping timing.

compiled_evidence.claim: The main launch path contains the timed host counter comparison/backedge and repeats selected CUDA launch dispatch until iterations is reached.
